# Triple & Co.

> AI-powered CMO & CRO as a Service for B2B tech companies. Triple & Co. gives founders one accountable partner: senior fractional marketing and revenue leadership from Lihi Pinto, combined with a supervised team of eight specialist AI marketing agents that do the work. Based in Tel Aviv, serving Israel, the United States, and Europe.

## What Triple & Co. does

Triple & Co. replaces the usual patchwork of a fractional executive, an agency, and a stack of freelancers with one operating system that runs strategy, execution, and AI-scaled delivery together. Every AI output passes a human before it ships.

- Senior CMO and CRO leadership, owned by founder Lihi Pinto
- Full-service execution: positioning, content, social, HubSpot, pipeline, events
- Eight supervised AI marketing agents: Camille (brand voice), Rex (growth strategy), Zara (social), Nova (research), Atlas (analytics), Sage (repurposing), Vega (art direction), Lumen (video)

## About Lihi Pinto

Founder of Triple & Co. and one of Israel's first native AI CMO/CROs. 15+ years in B2B SaaS and investment banking, $70M+ raised at companies where Lihi led marketing, across seed through growth rounds, revenue tripled repeatedly.
